utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still think we should settle the drop-off spot and pickup person first, just so it doesn’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. I can help once we’ve got the drop-off spot and pickup person set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that would really help. Once we’ve got those two sorted, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. Folks are gathering donations and spare parts this afternoon, and I can swing by later to see if they still need help sorting anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the time and place as soon as I hear it, and I’ll make sure the neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn—that’d be great. I’ll check in later and see if they need an extra pair of hands sorting everything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still waiting on the time and place, but I’ll pass along any update I hear as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. Just send the time and place when you hear back, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass along any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out and add to the supplies if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring up the repair drive and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still double-checking the list—could you tell me the exact time and which houses are on it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the exact time on hand, but I can check the list. It’s the houses on the repair drive route—let’s sort the details at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo—please check the list, and I’ll meet you at the community hall so we can sort out the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — let’s start with the front steps and the loose railing by the community hall. If you can grab the repair list, I’ll show you where to begin.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—so this is actually happening today, then? I’ll grab the repair list if you’re sure the front steps and railing are the priority.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s the plan—those two are the priority today. Grab the list and meet me by the community hall, and I’ll point you to the first fixes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 sounds fine to me. I’ll bring gloves and a couple trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 10 works for me. I’ll help check the path and move those loose boards.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10 with the gloves and trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 still works for me. What meeting spot should I tell the school parents to use?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The community center lot is easiest—tell them to meet by the main entrance at 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll tell everyone to meet by the main entrance at the community center lot at 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for checking on that, Opal. If you hear they’re short on anything, just let me know and I’ll try to round it up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear they’re short on anything for the community center drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll be around and ready to help with whatever they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah. I’m heading past the community center later, so I’ll check if they still need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that—just let me know if anything changes, since I can miss updates sometimes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll swing by later and keep you posted if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — if you tell me what supplies you already have, I’ll keep the list straight and note what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the basics covered, but I don’t have the full supplies list in front of me right now. I’ll check and let you know what’s still missing as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — just send it over when you can, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both. I can bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks—see you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the wrench set and screwdriver to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Vik—thank you. I’ll keep things organized on my end, and let me know if anyone’s able to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Rosa—I’ll pass along any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we heading out, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit worried about the logistics—do we have a drop-off spot and someone lined up for pickups? That would help me feel better before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We can use the community center for drop-off, and I’ll make sure the pickup details are sorted before we go.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks — just keep me posted on what’s still needed, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll pass along any new details I hear, especially what they still need. Thanks for being willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. Just keep me in the loop, and I’ll chip in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, 10 in the morning works for me. If you’ve got any extra gloves or trash bags, bring ’em along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So that’s confirmed for 10 in the morning, then? And do we still have the community center drop-off, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, 10 in the morning is still set, and the community center drop-off is still the plan. If anything changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo. That should help a lot — let me know when you’re headed over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’m heading over soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help, Ira—do you have a time in mind for the repair drive? I can spread the word to folks who need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard a firm time yet, but I’m stopping by the community center later and I’ll ask. If I find out, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. Just let me know when you hear, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both. I can bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus—thank you. I’ll let the neighbors know you’re bringing both over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Mara—I’ll bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still sorting what we need most, so just send me the rest as you get it and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll send over anything else I find. Do you want me to check for any other tools too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please—anything handy like hammers, screwdrivers, or a tape measure would be great. I’ll keep adding to the list as we go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the next stop for the repair drive now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good—if it’s the repair drive, I can stop by later and help sort things out. Just give me a shout if you need me sooner.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the next stop for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. Just keep me posted if anything changes—I might miss an update if it gets shuffled around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted and spread the word if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate it—just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help check the path and move those loose boards. Just let me know when you want to do it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Sam—thank you. I’ll work around the school schedule and let you know a time that fits.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye—just let me know when it works, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive—what else do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—I'm still double-checking the exact time and house list, and I'll let you know what we still need as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries—just send me the confirmed list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help out. I can keep it low-key and stay on standby.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
